dedupe_keys.name: ics simlab containerised simulation of industrial control systems for security research

description: An open-source suite for building several kinds of simulated industrial control systems. The arXiv abstract of paper 2509.23305 (IEEE CNS 2025 workshop) says ICS-SimLab uses Docker containers to create configurable ICS environments following the Purdue Enterprise Reference Architecture, with three preconfigured simulations: a solar panel smart grid, a water bottle filling facility and a system of intelligent electronic devices. The authors ran cyber attacks on these and recorded a dataset of malicious and benign network traffic for intrusion detection. The code is free to download from GitHub under the MIT licence. Coverage is simulated plants, not real sites. Caveats: the page read does not give the physical process detail or where the traffic dataset is stored. For simulation it supports testing how attacks on control networks disrupt industrial and energy processes. A related catalogue record is ICSSIM.
